english.title: Use a motor vehicle / trailer with equipment likely to cause danger of injury
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

when the condition of its accessories or equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), was such that its use involved a danger of injury to any person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This is an endorsable offence which requires proof that there was a danger of injury. For the less serious offences view H206, H207, H238, H239, H240 and H243.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H3100, H3102, H3103, H3104, H3105, H3106, H3107 and H3108.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) Fixed penalty ticket scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

dvlacode.description: Causing or likely to cause danger by reason of use of unsuitable vehicle or using a vehicle with parts or accessories (excluding brakes, steering or tyres) in a dangerous condition
